title: Phép giảng tám ngày (Cathechismus) — Alexandre de Rhodes, Rome 1651
notes: The Vietnamese Wikisource page 'Phép giảng tám ngày' (Latin title page 'Cathechismvs ... in octo dies divisus') is a page-by-page proofread transcription of Alexandre de Rhodes's catechism printed in Rome in 1651 by the Congregation de Propaganda Fide — the first printed prose work in chữ Quốc ngữ script; public domain. The harvested origin ('proofread keyed transcription of Cathechismus, Rome 1651') refers to this transcription, taken from the linked scan (Index:Phép giảng tám ngày.pdf).
